mapper.select:
select sum(withdraw_money) as total_withdrawal from member_withdraw_log
and DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{req.inclusive_date}
and member_id in (SELECT id from member_info where inviter_code = #{req.channelCode})
group by member_id

select ifnull(SUM(lvp.total_ticket),0.0) total_gift from ${dbLive}.live_video_prop lvp
and lvp.prop_id > 0
and DATE_FORMAT(lvp.create_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{req.inclusive_date}
and lvp.p_user_id in (select mi.id from ${dbMain}.member_info mi where mi.inviter_code = #{req.channelCode})
